name: branding-serpent-flower-symbol-with-phone-and-stationery
title: Black snake-loop flower symbol reversed on a coral phone and printed on a folder
whatItIs: A white slide with a large black symbol where one continuous snake bends into a six-lobed flower with a tiny eye at its head, a small caption 'kairo digital agency', and two photos: hands holding a coral phone with a white version, and a coral version on a white folder on grey.
whatItMeans: Clever and lively; a single animal loop becomes a flower, and coral makes it warm.
techniques: Form a symbol from one looping creature.
Add a tiny eye as the only detail.
Show black, white-on-coral and coral-on-white versions.

vocabulary.definition: A shape drawn as one unbroken loop.
An animal concealed inside a symbol.
A folder or card presenting a logo.
